note: SGSM3 is reported as causing a largely nonsyndromic intellectual disability phenotype with short stature, supporting the hypothesis that absence of severe progressive or degenerative findings differentiates it from complex syndromic entities.

evidence.text: SGSM3 biallelic loss-of-function variants were identified in siblings presenting with nonsyndromic intellectual disability phenotype and short stature.

source.title: A Strong Candidate Gene for Nonsyndromic Intellectual Disability Phenotype: SGSM3
source.quote: The report of two cases with bi-allelic LOF variants in the SGSM3 gene from different populations with similar clinical manifestations strengthens the potential of this gene as a candidate gene for the nonsyndromic ID phenotype.
